title: Humble SMP
description: A vanilla plus experience for the humble SMP server
body:
The Humble SMP modpack was created to provide players with an improved Minecraft experience.
It's a small list of mods because we find there is so much to do in the base game, we just wanted to provide a way to enjoy a casual vanilla Minecraft campaign with the benefits of a few quality of life mods that we don't normally get access too.

Overall this modpack's defining feature is that we keep that vanilla experience and are able to maintain a lengthy and enjoyable play through of Minecraft without being overwhelmed with unknown mods.
